summary: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.

scenes.narration: Guess what? An octopus has more than one heart!
scenes.headline: Guess what?

scenes.narration: Two hearts pump blood to its gills, so it can breathe underwater.
scenes.headline: Two for breathing

scenes.narration: The third heart pumps blood to the rest of its wiggly body.
scenes.headline: One for the body

scenes.narration: And here's the coolest part. Octopus blood is blue!
scenes.headline: Blue blood!

scenes.narration: Three hearts and blue blood. Now you know!
scenes.headline: Now you know!

title: Octopuses Have THREE Hearts?! 🐙 #Shorts
description: A fun fact for curious kids.
